WITH bucket_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 1 END) AS bucket1_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN ss_ext_tax END) AS bucket1_ext_tax_avg,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS bucket1_net_paid_avg,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 1 END) AS bucket2_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN ss_ext_tax END) AS bucket2_ext_tax_avg,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS bucket2_net_paid_avg,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 1 END) AS bucket3_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN ss_ext_tax END) AS bucket3_ext_tax_avg,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS bucket3_net_paid_avg,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 1 END) AS bucket4_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN ss_ext_tax END) AS bucket4_ext_tax_avg,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS bucket4_net_paid_avg,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 1 END) AS bucket5_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN ss_ext_tax END) AS bucket5_ext_tax_avg,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN ss_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS bucket5_net_paid_avg
    FROM store_sales
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN bucket1_count > 1071 THEN bucket1_ext_tax_avg ELSE bucket1_net_paid_avg END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN bucket2_count > 39161 THEN bucket2_ext_tax_avg ELSE bucket2_net_paid_avg END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN bucket3_count > 29434 THEN bucket3_ext_tax_avg ELSE bucket3_net_paid_avg END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN bucket4_count > 6568 THEN bucket4_ext_tax_avg ELSE bucket4_net_paid_avg END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN bucket5_count > 21216 THEN bucket5_ext_tax_avg ELSE bucket5_net_paid_avg END AS bucket5
FROM reason
CROSS JOIN bucket_stats
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
